 Best Black Friday Apple Deals: Save Up to 35% on AirPods, iPads, and More 
 Score editor-tested tech for less.
 By Sidney Lee Updated: Nov 02, 2026 11:37 AM EST View Products Save Article Share Article Women's Health may earn commission from the links on this page, but we only feature products we believe in. Why Trust Us? 
 W hether we’re popping in a pair of AirPods before a long run or checking our step count on our Apple Watches , we can’t resist Apple’s gear—especially while trying to hit our fitness goals. Our editors have used and tested Apple tech for years, so we know what’s worth your money and what’s not.
 Ahead of Black Friday and Cyber Monday Amazon is discounting previous models of top-tier tech. As a shopping editor who writes about sales for a living, I’ve been watching for notable markdowns, and right now, you can score iPads, headphones, and Apple accessories up to 35 percent off.
 Shop Amazon Sales on Apple Gear 
 The AirPods Pro 3 are discounted by 20 percent, and WH Executive Health & Fitness Director Jacqueline Andriakos reviewed the earbuds’ heart rate and fitness-tracking features. “The AirPods Pro 3’s in‑ear heart‑rate sensing is definitely a revelation for those days [when I forget my Apple Watch]: I can head out the door, get a workout in, and still get the HR and fitness tracking data (such as calorie burn) even when I don’t have my wearable on my wrist,” she writes.
 The AirPods Max 2 are rarely discounted, but right now you can save $100 on the Starlight and Orange colorways. There’s also deals on workout-ready Beats, AirTags, and iPads.
 Ahead, shop the best Black Friday Apple deals happening on Amazon now.

 Amazon If you have smaller ears, these earbuds actually fit inside your ears like a hearing aid with the help of flexible wingtips that really lock them in. These earbuds are small, but they deliver the top-tier sound quality you’ve come to expect from Beats. That includes the options to flip between active noise cancellation and transparency modes, so you can use these to tune out loud gym-goers or to be aware of your surroundings during outdoor workouts.

If you don’t want to drop $500+ on new tech, this model has everything you need from an up-to-date design and connectivity features.
